market_data_basis: Hyperliquid perpetuals for future target-market validation; Binance spot OHLCV is proxy research only and must be labeled

execution_cost_policy.unit: percent of entry notional, applied once per completed round trip
execution_cost_policy.note: The aggregate round-trip rate is charged once against entry notional per completed trade. 0.12% and 0.04% are diagnostic scenarios, not verified account-specific realized costs.

historical_periods.reason: The 20-asset breadth universe has a common-history constraint beginning around 2023-05. These dates are retrospective and are not the live rolling WFA input; they must not be represented as untouched or confirmatory.

next_confirmatory_test.rule: Choose a future time interval only after the protocol is committed; do not tune on it; evaluate once after sufficient bars accumulate.

execution_rules.signal_timing: signal calculated only from completed bars at timestamp t
execution_rules.same_bar_signal_exit: not allowed; exits begin no earlier than entry bar
execution_rules.ambiguous_same_bar_tp_sl: conservative stop-first assumption unless intrabar data resolves ordering
execution_rules.missing_or_invalid_data: fail closed; do not silently fill with another venue

acceptance_criteria.multiple_comparison_method: one-sided circular block bootstrap p-values and lower bounds with Bonferroni alpha=0.05/9 across three offsets and three baseline comparisons

stopping_rule.instruction: Do not tune parameters on the rejected holdout. Any new hypothesis requires a new versioned protocol and fresh unseen evaluation data.

known_limitations: This file records policy; existing backtest entry points do not yet universally enforce or hash-verify it.
A lock file alone does not prevent edits; enforcement and CI verification remain required.
The proposed 2022-2024 split is historical and contaminated by prior inspection, so it must not be used to claim confirmatory OOS proof.
No edge or profitability is asserted.

data_window_policy.source: Binance Spot public OHLCV proxy only
data_window_policy.cutoff: Explicit --as-of UTC timestamp; include only fully closed bars
data_window_policy.reproducibility: Record SHA-256 for every raw JSONL, protocol lock and simulator source
data_window_policy.note: An as-of cutoff alone does not freeze source data. Hashes are required to identify the exact snapshot.
